root_cause.text: The qrtr_ns_remove() function destroys the workqueue before restoring the original sk_data_ready callback, allowing a race where a packet arriving after destroy_workqueue() triggers the custom data_ready callback to queue work on the freed workqueue, causing use-after-free.
root_cause.evidence: CVE description: "if a packet arrives after destroy_workqueue() is called, but before sock_release(), the qrtr_ns_data_ready() callback will try to queue the work, causing use-after-free issue." Patch moves the restoration of `sk_data_ready` to the start of `qrtr_ns_remove()` (and adds `synchronize_net()`) to prevent this race.
